compared_against.selection: git-tracked .md, .txt, .json, .jsonl, .yaml and .yml files under USER.md, SOUL.md, identity/alpha, instances/alpha and memory, at commit 798e1c35bdde937aed6fa328b195a54d3dbf1888

limitations: Short prompts share common phrases ("what is the") with any large English text, so containment above zero is expected.
A lexical comparison cannot prove that no idea, situation or persona was drawn from the compared files.
Only git-tracked files were compared; untracked local files and real conversations held elsewhere were not.
comparison.method: Each text becomes a set of trigrams: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric token trigrams, plus trigrams of consecutive CJK characters (U+3400 to U+9FFF). For each prompt, containment is the share of its trigrams found anywhere in the compared files.
comparison.normalized_exact_method: A prompt's ASCII tokens and CJK characters joined by single spaces, searched for in the same normalisation of each compared file.
comparison.result: zero-normalized-exact-matches; the highest containment is two common three-word phrases in a five-trigram factual question
